manifest.description: Diagnose unbounded growth: a collection, cache, queue, buffer, or accumulator that grows without an obvious bound or eviction policy, risking unbounded memory or latency growth under sustained load.
when_to_use: a cache or map is inserted into but never evicted or capped
a queue or buffer is pushed to faster than it is drained, or has no backpressure
an accumulator/log/vector grows for the lifetime of a long-lived process
a profile, OOM report, or operator hint points at memory that climbs and never returns
anti_patterns: do not flag a collection whose lifetime is a single bounded request/scope
do not flag growth that is provably bounded by a small domain (enum, fixed key set)
do not assert a leak without showing the missing eviction/bound or a growth measurement
do not propose an eviction policy that changes correctness (dropping needed state) without saying so
